text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um... I just couldn't stop thinking about 
what El said in her sleep last night...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She was shouting names of Spanish dishes 
all night long, like "Plancha!" and 
"Gazpacho!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Geez, El... Just how articulate can one's 
sleep-talking get?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I couldn't fall asleep 
until morning... *yawn*...
It seems Grass Wonder is lacking sleep...
